title: KHR_node_camera_hint glTF Node Extension
description: Associates a node with a passive, advisory camera descriptor. The node's global transform supplies an authored pose using the core camera convention with scaling ignored.

role.description: Nonempty semantic role for this camera hint. Standard and custom roles classify authored intent but do not select or activate a camera.

camera.description: Advisory index of a glTF camera whose projection definition is associated with this hint. The reference does not instantiate the camera or override node.camera.
camera.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `cameras` array. Extensions on the referenced camera retain their own support contracts.

targetNode.description: Index of a different glTF node whose global translation supplies an advisory forward direction. The direction does not define up, roll, or a complete orientation; coincident positions use the hint node's authored rotation.
targetNode.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `nodes` array and MUST NOT refer to the node containing this extension.

label.description: Nonempty human-readable label for authoring tools and inspectors. It has no camera behavior.
